```yaml
name: Update MS Learn Dates

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  update-dependencies:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up PowerShell
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
      with:
        dotnet-version: '6.0'

    - name: Install Bicep CLI
      run: |
        az extension add --name bicep

    - name: Build Bicep templates
      run: |
        bicep build .\src\Core\metadata.bicep
        bicep build .\src\Analytics\metadata.bicep
        bicep build .\src\Exports\metadata.bicep
        bicep build .\src\ManagedExports\metadata.bicep

    - name: Run test plan
      run: |
        # Placeholder for actual test plan commands
        echo "Test plan verification not implemented yet."

    - name: Commit changes
      run: |
        git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
        git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
        git add .
        git commit -m "Update dependencies and add metadata files"

    - name: Push changes
      run: git push origin main
```
